== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "[[Chris DeJong]] and [[Brad DeFruiter]] are '98 Star Trek CCG finalists who've fought their way back to the Big Show in '99. Great guys, amazing players." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
